## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-09-23: S-1 first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2
- 2021-10-26: Up-C IPO closes; executed TRA dated October 26, 2021 filed as Exhibit 10.13 to the closing 8-K

#### WES merger and termination

- 2025-08-06: 8-K reports Merger Agreement with Western Midstream Partners; concurrent TRA Amendment terminates the TRA at the Effective Time for an aggregate $80 million cash payment
- 2025-10-15: WES merger closes; TRA terminated on the Closing Date with $80 million paid to TRA Holders

## Explanation

Aris Water Solutions completed its Up-C IPO on October 26, 2021 and executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with pre-IPO holders covering cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by exchanges of Solaris LLC units for Aris Class A common stock. The recognized TRA liability climbed from $75.6 million at year-end 2021 to roughly $98.9 million at year-end 2024 as exchanges occurred. On August 6, 2025, concurrent with the Western Midstream merger agreement, Aris and the Majority TRA Holders signed a TRA Amendment that terminated the contract at the merger Effective Time and substituted an aggregate $80 million cash payment for the Section 4.5(b) Early Termination Payment formula. The merger closed on October 15, 2025, the TRA terminated that day, and the $80 million was paid. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
